page.layout: One printed page, text block in the centre of the left-hand page: running text in a single column, then a printed ornament, with the catchword at the lower right. The left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: In illis ergò sacrificiis, quid nobis esset do-nandum, figuratè significabatur. In hoc autem sacrificio, quid nobis jam donatum sit, evidenter ostenditur. In illis sacrificiis pronunciabatur Filius Dei pro impiis occidendus: in hoc autem pro impiis annunciatur occisus, testante Apostolo Rom. 5.

page.notes: The page number is printed in an ornamental bracket, "(o)", transcribed as "o". The ornament below the text is a printer's tailpiece and is not transcribed. The left strip is the edge of the adjoining page and was left out. "Index" at the lower right is treated as a catchword.
